name: edit-replace
summary: find and replace text in a file using a regex pattern
description: Search every line of FILE for PATTERN (POSIX extended regex) and replace with TEXT. By default replaces only the first match per line; use -g to replace all. Use -i for case-insensitive matching. The file is updated atomically via a temp file and rename.

options.description: POSIX extended regex to search for
replace all occurrences per line (default: first)
